components.input_conditions: Public positive-curvature quadratic and indexed component oracle.
components.parameter_and_cost_changes: Dimension remains one; discovering the hidden index requires order n component calls for the stated uniform-success goal.
components.preserved_model_properties: All components are coercive C-infinity quadratics. F gap is Z^2Delta/9<=Delta. D^p Lipschitz constant is zero for all p>=2.
components.transcript_control: The pre-hit true transcript equals the all-quadratic counterfactual transcript for the same private tape.
components.transformation: Place the entire linear term -4n epsilon Zx in one uniformly hidden component; averaging cancels n in the resulting objective shift.

construction.definition: For independent uniform I_* in [n] and Z in {-3,-1,1,3}, set gamma=72epsilon^2/Delta and f_i(x)=gamma x^2/2-4n epsilon Z 1_{i=I_*}x. Then F(x)=gamma x^2/2-4epsilon Zx, starting at 0.
construction.hidden_objects: I_* and Z are drawn once before interaction, independently of the algorithm's private tape, and remain fixed.
construction.parameters: n>=1, Delta,epsilon>0, fixed integer p>=2, d=1. Any nonnegative pth-derivative Lipschitz allowance is admissible because the actual constant is zero.
construction.public_information: The family, n,p,Delta,epsilon,gamma, domain R and initial point 0 may all be known; I_* and Z are not revealed.

escape_conditions.epistemic_note: Immediate consequence of the explicit oracle formula; outside the indexed hidden-information model.
escape_conditions.scope: Different oracle or disclosed hidden index
escape_conditions.statement: A full-objective gradient query reveals Z from F'(x)=gamma x-4epsilon Z, and revealing I_* permits direct interrogation of the perturbed component.

escape_conditions.epistemic_note: A transfer condition, not hardness established for the restricted class.
escape_conditions.statement: Additional lower-order smoothness restrictions can exclude gamma=72epsilon^2/Delta for small Delta.

hardness_claims.algorithm_coverage: Unrestricted randomized measurable adaptive component-query algorithms with arbitrary real queries, stopping and unqueried outputs.
hardness_claims.missing_lifting: No lifting to full-objective access, expected budgets or the nontrivial chain term is asserted.
hardness_claims.regime_note: At most N calls on every path: average success <=N/n+1/4; if N<=n/16 success <=5/16. Gives a fixed worst-case instance for each algorithm and Omega(n) necessary cap for uniform success >=2/3.

oracle_realizations.choices_and_history: Indices, points, stopping and output may depend measurably on prior replies and an independent private tape. The oracle is exact and deterministic after the hidden pair is fixed.
oracle_realizations.cost: One complete component p-jet reply costs one query.
oracle_realizations.information_bottleneck: Until index I_* is queried, all feedback equals the public quadratic jet and contains no information about Z. Coupling to that transcript bounds hit probability by N/n under cap N.
oracle_realizations.information_to_error: Success means |gamma xhat-4epsilon Z|<=epsilon. The four possible successful intervals are pairwise disjoint, so a no-hit output succeeds with conditional probability at most 1/4.
oracle_realizations.query_and_feedback: For arbitrary i in [n] and x in R, return f_i(x)=gamma x^2/2-a_i x, f_i'(x)=gamma x-a_i, f_i''(x)=gamma and zero derivatives of orders 3 through p, where a_i=4n epsilon Z 1_{i=I_*}. For p=2 the reply ends at the second derivative.
oracle_realizations.sampling_and_reuse: No fresh oracle noise. Repeated component indices query the same fixed function; arbitrary points and index reuse are permitted.

use_restrictions: Performance and membership depend on the linked local theorem's independent review.
Convex members suffice for hardness within a class allowing nonconvex functions; nonconvexity of each member is not required.

links.note: Complete local argument checks gap, coercivity and zero pth-derivative Lipschitz constant.
Only additive n hardness under the stated indexed-query cap.

research_use.reason: Separates component discovery from chain-progress hardness.

summary: A single unknown component contains a fixed linear perturbation of a public quadratic. Complete component p-jets remain uninformative about its four-valued shift until that index is queried.
title: Hidden-component quadratic family for additive n hardness
use_when: Realize the additive component-query lower bound with a bounded-below one-dimensional family.
